EXECUTION SUBORDINATION,NONDISTURBANCE ANDATTORNMENTAGREEMENT (Infrastructure Garage Lease) made effective as of the 30th day of November,2018,by and between the CondominiumBoard of Time Warner Center Condominium (the “Board"), having its office at Time Warner Center (f/k/a 10 Columbus Circle), New York,New York 10019,and Deutsche Bank AG New York Branch, a German corporation, having an office at c/o Jones Lang LaSalle Americas, Inc., JLL Center, 260 Forbes Avenue, Suite 1330, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania 15222 ("Tenant"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, A/R Garage LLC ("Lessor") is the owner of the Garage Unit (Lot 1001), （the“Unit")asdefined in thatcertainDeclarationof AOL TimeWarner Center Condominium dated as of July 22, 2003 (together with the Condominium By-Laws (and all exhibits) annexed thereto,as the same is now and may be amended from time to time in accordance with their hereto and made a part hereof, together with rights to certain Limited Common Elements and Exclusive Use General Common Elements appurtenant thereto, all as set forth in the Condominium Documents. All capitalized terms not defined herein shall have the meanings set forth in the Condominium Documents; WHEREAS,pursuant to that certain Infrastructure Garage Lease dated as of November restated from time to time, the “Lease"), Lessor leased to Tenant that portion of the Unit (togetherwithrights tocertainLimitedCommonElements and ExclusiveUseGeneral Common Elements appurtenant thereto, all as set forth in the Condominium Documents), all as more fully described in the Lease (as such leased space same be expanded or reduced from time to time in accordance with the terms of the Lease, the“Leased Premises"); WHEREAS,Section 34 of the Lease provides that the Lease is subordinate to the Condominium Documents, subject to certain terms and conditions stated in the Lease; and WHEREAS, as permitted under the terms of the Condominium Documents, the Board has agreed to provide for the non-disturbance of Tenant by the Board, and to provide for the recognition by the Board of the Lease, including all benefits, rights and conditions that Tenant enjoys under the Lease subject to the termshereof; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the promises and of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. Tenantcovenantsandagrees that theLeaseand therightsofTenantthereunder are and shall be at all times subject and subordinate. in all respects to the Condominium Documents,including,without limitation,theBoard's lien on the applicableUnit for General Common Charges, subject, however, to the provisions of this Agreement. 2. The Board agrees that so long as: (i) the Lease is in full force and effect (including any extension or renewal period thereofwhich maybe exercised in accordancewith the terms of the Lease); and (ii) Tenant is not in default under the Lease beyond any applicable notice and grace period and abides by all of the other provisions hereof, (a) the Board shall not theBoard byreason of anydefaultof theLessor under the CondominiumDocumentswhich entitles the Board to foreclose upon its lien,or in connection with any Succession,unless required by law in order tomake such action or proceeding effective,in which case the Board may join Tenant as a defendant in such action only for such purpose and not to terminate the Lease or otherwise diminish or interfere with Tenant's rights under the Lease or this Agreement in such action, (b) the Lease and Tenant's rights thereunder (including without limitation Tenant's right of possession, use and quiet enjoyment of the Leased Premises during the term of the Lease and any extension or renewal thereof in accordancewith the terms of the Lease shall not be terminated, altered, disturbed or extinguished by any action of the Board or any New Owner (as hereinafter defined), including, without limitation, by any suit, action or proceeding for the foreclosure of the Leased Premises (or any portion thereof) or otherwise for the enforcement of the Board's rights or remedies under the Condominium Documents,and (c) the New Owner shall, subject to the terms of this Agreement, recognize the Lease and the Tenant's rights as lessee thereunder. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, the Board and anyNew Owner upon becoming the owner of the applicable Unit Tenant under the Lease beyond any applicable notice and grace period. 3. If the Board (or any New Owner) shall become the owner of the Unit by reason of the foreclosure or other action described in Paragraph 2 hereof, or the Unit shall be sold or acquired as a result of any foreclosure by the Board, or transfer of ownership by deed given in lieu of foreclosure by the Board or the Unit shall be voluntarily surrendered to or acquired by the Board (or its designee) pursuant to the Condominium Documents, including, without limitation, Section16.1of theDeclaration andSection2.2.2(f)of theCondominiumBy-Lawsor by applicable laws (collectively,a“Succession;”and the date on which such Succession occurs, the "Succession Date"), the Lease shall automatically continue in full force and effect,without necessity for executing any new lease as a direct lease between Tenant and any subsequent owner of the Unit taking title through a Succession (a “New Owner"), as “landlord,” and the Board or the New Owner, as the case may be,shall assume the Lease and all obligations of landlord thereunder, upon all of the same terms, covenants and provisions contained in the Lease,provided,however,theBoard ortheNewOwnershall notbe: (i) bound by any fixed rent which Tenant might have paid for more than one (1) month in advance of its due date under the Lease to any prior landlord (including, without limitation, Lessor); unless otherwise consented to by either the Board or the New Owner, as applicable, or unless such prepaid amount is actually received by the Board or the New Owner, asapplicable; (i)liable for any previous act or omission of any prior landlord (including without limitation, Lessor) in violation of the Lease, except to the extent such act or omission (x) continues after theSuccession Date or (y)except to the extent such act or omission relates to the USISANDLCH\17834324.2

performance of a repair or maintenance obligation of which the Board has been given notice and an opportunity to cure as setforth in the Lease; or (ii) subject to any (A) claims, counterclaims or defenses which Tenant might have against any prior landlord (including, without limitation, Lessor), except to the extent the same continue after the Succession Date or (B) any offsets, abatements or credits,except offsets, abatements or credits,in each case which are expressly provided forin the Lease; or (iv) liable for the return of any: security deposit; overpayments of taxes, operating expenses, merchant association dues (other than overpayments of General Common Charges and/or Special Assessments received by the Board on account of the Unit and for which Tenant made payments under the Lease, to the extent Landlord is entitled to reimbursement of such amounts under the Condominium Documents and tothe extent Tenant is entitled to reimbursement of such amounts under the Lease), or other items of additional rent paid in estimates in advance by Tenant subject to subsequent adjustment; other monies which pursuant to the Lease are payable by Lessor to Tenant; in each case to the extent not delivered’to the Board or the New Owner, as the case may be, but subject in any case to subparagraph (i) above; or prior landlord (including, without limitation, Lessor) pursuant to the provisions of the Lease, to in connectionwith any such constructionwork,or for any other allowances or cashpayments (i) above; it being agreed that Tenant shall have the right perform all or any portion of the InfrastructureWork(whetherwithinoroutsideof thePremises)andoffset theActualCost manner as Tenant may offset against rent for permitted self-help work in accordance with Section9 of theLease. Tenant hereby agrees that, upon the Board or the New Owner becoming the owner of a Unit pursuant to this Paragraph 3, Tenant shall attorn to the Board or the New Owner (or any subsequent owner),as the case may be,and theLease shall continue in full force and effect,in accordancewithits terms.Nothingcontained hereinshall be deemed tomodify theobligations of the Board under the CondominiumDocuments. The Board hereby agrees that, so long as the Board (or its nominee) shall be the owner of  the Unit pursuant to this paragraph 3, all of the obligations of the Board to the owner of the Unit under the Condominium Documents in respect of the Leased Premises as in effect prior to respect of the Leased Premises in accordancewith the terms of the CondominiumDocuments as if the owner of the Unit was an independent arm's length party, and Tenant shall be entitled to and may enforce such obligations of theBoard in the name of the Unit Owner in accordance with the Condominium Documents as if Tenant was the independent arm's length owner of the Unit subject to any rights of other tenants or occupants of the Unit if Tenant does not occupy the entire Unit. 4. No provision of this Agreement shall be construed to make the Tenant liable for any covenants and obligations of Lessor under the Condominium Documents. 5. Tenant shall give written notice in accordance with Paragraph 9 hereof of any default by Lessor under the Lease to the Board promptly after such notice is given to Lessor. 6. The Board or New Owner shall take title to the Unit subject to, and shall assume, any non-disturbance agreement that the prior Landlord (including Lessor) shall have entered into with any subtenant of Tenant in accordance the Lease. 7. The Board agrees, from time to time upon request (but not more than twice a  year), to state in writing to Tenant, whether or not, to the best of the Board's actual knowledge, anydefaultorEventofDefaulton thepartof Lessorexistsunder theCondominiumDocuments and the nature of any such default or Event of Default and such other matters related to the Condominium Documents as Tenant may reasonably request, and such statement shall act as a waiverofanyclaimbetweenTenant and theBoard totheextentsuchclaimisbaseduponfacts contrary to those assertedin the statement and to the extentTenant iswithout knowledge offacts to the contrary of those contained in the statement,and Tenant has acted in reasonablereliance upon the statementprovided,however,that:(i)theissuance of such statementshallinnoevent subject theBoard to any liabilityfor the negligent or inadvertent failure of theBoard to disclose correct and/or relevant information and (i) such issuance shall not be construed to waive any rights of the Board with respect to any audit of or adjustments to General Common Charges as provided for in the Condominium Documents, or to challenge acts committed by a Unit Owner for which approval by or consent of the Board was required but not sought or obtained. The Condominium Board shall be entitled to charge Tenant a reasonable fee for preparing and renderingsaidstatement. 8.' The parties further agree that this Agreement shall terminate and be void automatically, immediately upon the expiration or earlier termination of the Lease, and without the need for any termination or other agreement being recorded to evidence such termination.Notwithstanding theforegoing andwithout in any way affecting the automatic termination of this Agreement as aforesaid, the parties agree to execute, deliver and submitforrecordationaMemorandumofTerminationconfirming theterminationof this Agreement, promptly following the expiration or earlier termination of the Lease. 13.
